:::{#def-design-matrix}
#### Design matrix

In a regression model with $n$ observations and $p$ predictors,
the **design matrix** (or **model matrix**) $\mX$
is the $n \times p$ matrix whose $i$-th row is the covariate vector $\tp{\vx_i}$
for observation $i$:

$$
\mX =
\begin{bmatrix}
\tp{\vx_1} \\
\tp{\vx_2} \\
\vdots \\
\tp{\vx_n}
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
x_{11} & x_{12} & \cdots & x_{1p} \\
x_{21} & x_{22} & \cdots & x_{2p} \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
x_{n1} & x_{n2} & \cdots & x_{np}
\end{bmatrix}
$$

:::
